Metrics.Name: graph2otel.api.unexpected
Metrics.Description: Microsoft API responses that did not match what this collector was built against, by kind. Non-zero means an assumption needs re-checking; see the WARN log for the offending value.

Metrics.Name: intune.enrollment_config.count
Metrics.Description: Intune device enrollment configurations, by config type.

Metrics.Name: intune.enrollment_config.priority
Metrics.Description: Evaluation priority of each Intune device enrollment configuration. Lower values win: a user in scope for multiple configurations of the same type is subject only to the one with the lowest priority value - a higher number is NOT higher precedence.

Metrics.Name: intune.enrollment_config.version
Metrics.Description: Version counter of each Intune device enrollment configuration, for change detection.
